symptom: create or modify consumed odata service over a Studio Pro client: UseQuerySegment true -> false, Icon, CustomLocationTemplate and the empty ApplicationId/EndpointId/CatalogUrl/proxy/microflow keys deleted, MetadataReferences [3] -> [0], ValidatedEntities [1] -> [0]
cause: consumedODataServiceToGen writes the document wholesale from a model that holds none of these; placeholders (UseQuerySegment false, ExportLevel Hidden) and addStrIf-omitted empties replaced what Studio Pro stored
fix: UpdateConsumedODataService lays the fresh document over the stored one: placeholder keys keep the stored value, an omitted optional key is written "" when stored (so a cleared value stays cleared), lists keep the stored marker
insight: When the model is a strict subset of the stored document, overlay onto the stored bytes rather than growing the model field by field; but an optional key the writer omits must become "" rather than be carried, or clearing it through alter silently stops working
